description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to understand the memory-workflow system and its three-layer architecture (file + FTS5 + KG). 2. It installs the skill by prepending the `<!-- [memory-workflow] 已安装 -->` marker and `## 每次消息时` section to AGENTS.md. 3. It runs `memory_ops.py store --content '...' --tag '...'` eight times for each note in raw_research_notes.txt, using the correct tags. The store command internally checks for duplicates at Jaccard >= 0.85 (proprietary threshold), but since all 8 are submitted and dedup runs separately, some may pass through. 4. It runs `memory_ops.py dedup` which uses the proprietary 0.85 Jaccard threshold to remove near-duplicates (NOTE 3 duplicates NOTE 1, NOTE 6 duplicates NOTE 2). 5. It runs `memory_ops.py search --query '机器学习优化算法' --limit 3 --llm-answer` and saves the full JSON output to search_results.json. The agent must know to use the `--llm-answer` flag (from SKILL.md) and `--limit 3`. The search uses the proprietary character N-gram Jaccard + FTS5 BM25 + time-decay reranking pipeline — not standard keyword or vector search.
